title: Follow-up: bind exact source semantic values in obligation authority
description: Track the deferred source-value contract work identified during correction of PR #475. Add independently authoritative, source-backed predicates/value bindings for mechanically relevant values such as save ability/DC, damage amount/type/trigger, target count, duration amount/unit, reset timing, and transition payload. This is deliberately outside eshyra-o9bd.19.1.11.1 because it requires exact source values; assign to the sibling source-value bead rather than widening the readiness-dimension correction.
acceptance_criteria: Source-derived value bindings are authoritative, validated against evidence, preserved through closure, and covered by cross-kind mutation regressions.
close_reason: Duplicate of eshyra-o9bd.19.1.10 (Model exact source values and relationships in the obligation authority), which was created by the supervisor decomposition of PR #475 and carries the same scope. Consolidated there to keep closure accounting at eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 correct.
